title: Planck units mark where our two best theories collide
body: Combining c, Planck's constant and Newton's G yields natural units: a Planck length near 1.6 x 10^-35 metres and time near 5 x 10^-44 seconds. Below those scales, quantum mechanics and general relativity must both apply and neither suffices alone. The numbers are not a wall in nature so much as a border between our maps.
